item.title: Web no Naka no Tenshi-tachi
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Chiffon, Serene
  • 発売日: 2002-05-17
  • スコア: なし (3 人評価)
  • 日本語名: Webの中の天使達
  • 英語名: Web no Naka no Tenshi-tachi

あらすじ

Is this a nightmare or what? Just an hour ago, Kyosuke Takei’s girlfriend up and dumped him! He feels so hopeless and depressed, but he soon finds access to a new dating service website. To his surprise, he finds all different types of girls, from housewives to students. This is paradise; they all listen to him and help mend is wounded heart.

  • 日本語名: Webの中の彼女 ～パスワードに秘められた謎～
  • 英語名: Web no Naka no Kanojo Password ni Himerareta Nazo

あらすじ

Main character is a university student. He uses internet just for nanpa (meeting women,) but once got interested in the ruined village sinking into the dam by accident. Strange things start to happen around the hero - first he starts to receive intimidation letters, then his informant suddenly dies…
